name: Pause Menu Studio
description: Move pause-menu elements, save named layouts, and add configurable level, song, coin, and difficulty cards.

enabled.name: Enable Pause Menu Studio
enabled.description: Enables custom pause-menu layouts and information cards.

preset.name: Menu style
preset.description: Classic keeps the original layout, Compact makes it smaller, and Showcase leaves more room for information cards.

show-level.name: Level name
show-level.description: Shows the current level name and creator.

show-song.name: Music
show-song.description: Shows the current song name, artist, and SongID when available.

show-coins.name: Coins
show-coins.description: Shows how many user coins the level contains.

show-difficulty.name: Difficulty
show-difficulty.description: Shows the level difficulty and star count.

show-demon-rank.name: Demonlist position
show-demon-rank.description: Shows the AREDL or Pemonlist position for eligible demons when Integrated Demonlist is installed.

edit-on-open.name: Edit mode on open
edit-on-open.description: Opens the pause menu in drag mode. You can also use the EDIT button in the pause menu.

snap-grid.name: Snap to grid
snap-grid.description: Rounds the final position to a 5-unit grid after you release the element. Dragging remains smooth.

separate-mode-layouts.name: Separate layouts by mode
separate-mode-layouts.description: Keeps positions, hidden blocks, and named layouts separate for normal, platformer, creator, and creator-platformer pause menus.

advanced-transform.name: Advanced transform controls
advanced-transform.description: Adds rotation, opacity, and drawing-layer controls to the selected-block panel in Edit Mode.

undo-history-limit.name: Undo history size
undo-history-limit.description: Maximum number of editor actions retained for Undo and Redo during the current pause menu.

check-updates-on-startup.name: Check on startup
check-updates-on-startup.description: Checks GitHub for a newer Pause Menu Studio release while Geode is loading. Manual checks from Edit Mode remain available when disabled.

show-update-loading-banner.name: Loading-screen banner
show-update-loading-banner.description: Shows the available-version banner on Geometry Dash's Geode loading screen.

show-update-badges.name: Update badges
show-update-badges.description: Shows the red exclamation mark above the pause-menu Edit button and the Updates toolbar button.
